einzeiler: The federal task force targets the Aujay case with a major drug sting.
kurzfassung: Brandenburg is removed from the Aujay case while the LASD continues the investigation alongside a federal task force. Using wiretaps and informants over 18 months, the team executes a major drug sting in Antelope Valley. The operation also secures a key witness for the Aujay case.
stichpunkte: Brandenburg is taken off the Aujay case
LASD collaborates with Hager and the federal task force
Investigation utilizes wiretaps and informants over 18 months
Execution of a major drug sting in Antelope Valley history
Securing a key witness in the Aujay case
beschreibung:
Brandenburg is taken off the Aujay case, but the LASD can’t stop Hager and the federal task force. With the help of wiretaps, informants, and 18 months of investigation, the team pulls off one of the largest drug stings in Antelope Valley history and nets a key witness in the Aujay case.
